name: TimeZoneDB
tagline: REST API for timezone lookup by zone name, coordinates, city, or IP
description: TimeZoneDB is a free-to-register REST API that returns local time, GMT offset, DST status, and related timezone metadata. Free endpoints support lookup by IANA zone name or lat/lng; premium unlocks city-name and IP lookups plus higher reliability on vip.timezonedb.com. Responses are XML or JSON (XML default). Free tier is personal/non-commercial only, with a strict one-request-per-second rate limit.

auth.details: API key passed as required query parameter `key` (e.g. ?key=YOUR_API_KEY). Free self-serve signup at timezonedb.com/register.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Unlimited queries for personal/non-commercial use; 1 request/second rate limit (additional requests blocked)
pricing.paid_plans: Premium from $5/month or $50/year: city & IP lookup, unlimited queries, no rate limit, vip host, priority support

rate_limits: Free: 1 request per second. Premium: no rate limit applied.
use_cases: get current local time and offset for an IANA timezone name
resolve timezone, DST, and local time from latitude and longitude
convert a Unix timestamp between two timezones
list all supported timezones or filter by country code
look up timezone by city name or IP address (premium)
